Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely fixed the target city as Hilversum by treating UMG’s “corporate headquarters” as the relevant HQ, ignoring the common/operational HQ in Santa Monica and not reconciling the ambiguity. This misidentification of the headquarters city led the workflow to pursue Hilversum-specific results for “ethnic minorities looked at differently,” sending the investigation down the wrong path and causing the ultimate failure to reach the correct numeric answer.
